token.description: The token from the invitation e-mail. Sent in the body rather than in the path, because a bearer secret in a URL path ends up in access logs and in the Referer of anything the page loads.

AccountDeletionImpactDto.description: What deleting the current user's account would do to their teams

blocked.description: Whether the deletion is refused: the user is the only admin of at least one team that has other members (SOLE_TEAM_ADMIN), or of a team migrated from biketeam (SOLE_MIGRATED_TEAM_ADMIN)

blockingTeams.description: Teams the user is the only admin of while other members remain; they must name another admin, or delete the team, before deleting their account. Excludes the teams listed in migratedTeams

deletedTeams.description: Teams the user administers and is the only member of; they are deleted with the account. Excludes the teams listed in migratedTeams

migratedTeams.description: Teams the user is the only admin of, with or without other members, that were migrated from biketeam: their old biketeam addresses redirect to them. Each one refuses the deletion until another admin is named (or, for a platform admin, the switch-over is cancelled on biketeam and the team deleted)

ActivateAccountRequest.description: Activates an account from its verification link: the password is chosen here, by whoever holds the mailbox, never at sign-up.

AdContactRequest.description: A message to relay to the author of an ad

message.description: The message body, plain text. Rendered as text in the email: any markup is escaped rather than interpreted.
examples: Bonjour, le vélo est-il toujours disponible ? Je peux passer samedi.

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the description, flattened (links become their label) and cut on a word boundary at about 200 characters. Null when the description holds no text. Lets a list row render its two lines without the description being sent at all — see the 'view' parameter.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL template of the ad's first picture, the one a card shows. Saves a compact row from carrying media.assets just to find it. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

images.description: URL templates of every picture on the ad, in editor order — the gallery. Present whatever the 'view', so a compact row can show a carousel without pulling media.assets. The first entry is the same picture as 'thumbnailUrl'.

rentalPeriod.description: Period the price applies to, for a rental — render as 'price / period'. Null for a sale, and for a rental whose period has not been set.

locationGeometry.description: Approximate location of the ad, deliberately blurred: the point is the centre of a fixed cell about 1 km across, not the seller's address. Enough to tell a nearby ad from a distant one, and the same value on every read so repeated calls cannot be averaged back to the exact position. Null when the ad has no location. The exact point stays on AdEditDto, and only for the seller: the team's admins get this blurred point there too. Proximity filters measure from this blurred point too, never from the exact one.

createdByDisplayName.description: Display name of the member who posted the ad. The only thing about them this DTO carries: there is no contact channel on an Ad, and inventing one (an email, a phone number) is a product decision, not a serialisation one.

tags.description: The team's AD tags the ad carries, sorted by label. Empty when it carries none.

locationGeometry.description: Location coordinates [longitude, latitude]. Exact for the ad's author only; any other editor (a team admin, a platform admin) gets the same blurred point as AdDto, the centre of a cell about 1 km across. Sending that blurred point back unchanged in an update by a non-author keeps the stored exact point; any other value replaces it.

tags.description: The team's AD tags the ad carries, sorted by label — what the edit form's tagIds starts from.

tagIds.description: IDs (TSID) of the team's AD tags the ad carries, replacing the whole set — at most 10, each a tag of this team and of kind AD, else 400 (TAG_INVALID, TOO_MANY_TAGS). An empty list removes them all. Omitted: none on a creation, left as they are on an update.

AddMemberRequest.description: Request to add a member to the team

AdminDomainAliasDto.description: Admin view of a domain alias (dedicated hostname pinned to a team)

androidFingerprints.description: Android app SHA-256 certificate fingerprints for passkey origin verification (comma-separated, colon-hex format)

enableGpxPlanner.description: Whether the interactive planner is open in the GPX tools

androidFingerprints.description: Android app SHA-256 certificate fingerprints for passkey origin verification (comma-separated, colon-hex format)

teamCount.description: Number of teams in this domain

userCount.description: Number of users in this domain

clientId.description: OAuth client ID (consumer key for OAuth 1.0a)

oauthVersion.description: OAuth protocol of the client ID and secret

AdminTeamAttributesRequest.description: Platform admin request to update team governance attributes

visibilityEditable.description: Whether team admins can change visibility

joinable.description: Whether any domain user can join this public team

addMemberAllowed.description: Whether team admins can add members

enableRoutePlanner.description: Whether the interactive route planner is open to this team

AdminTeamDto.description: Admin team view with domain info

domainId.description: Domain ID this team belongs to

visibilityEditable.description: Whether visibility is editable by team admins

joinable.description: Whether any domain user can join this team

addMemberAllowed.description: Whether team admins can add members

enableRoutePlanner.description: Whether the interactive route planner is open to this team

AdminUserDto.description: Admin user view with domain info

domainId.description: Domain ID this user belongs to

AnalyticsConfigDto.description: Audience measurement settings for the site

countPath.description: Same-origin path the site sends a page view to (for example /count), without the query string.

url.description: Download URL. Opaque: it may carry a query string (a cache-buster that changes when the file is replaced); use it as is.

imageUrl.description: Image URL template. Opaque: it may carry a query string (a cache-buster that changes when the file is replaced); substitute {size} only.

size.description: Size in bytes of the file a download returns (an image as re-encoded on upload); null while not yet known. Ignored in requests.

assetId.description: Id of the asset, as the request cited it

AssetsDto.description: Assets of a content. On a write, the logo, images and attachments must each be an asset uploaded to this team and attached to no other content, else 400 ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE naming the asset id — the same answer whether the id is unknown, of another team or held by another content.

AssignPlatformRoleRequest.description: Request to assign or remove platform role

role.description: Platform role to assign (null to remove)

refreshToken.description: Refresh token, for mobile clients. On a refresh, the rotated token — absent when the refresh came within the grace of a rotation made by another one, whose token stands.

BetaSignupDto.description: A beta program sign-up, as seen by an admin

BetaSignupRequest.description: A request to be notified and added to a beta program once one opens

email.description: Email to contact once a beta is open

BlockedUsersResponse.description: The members the current user blocked, most recent first

BoundsDto.description: Geographic bounding box, in WGS84 degrees

end.description: Event end date/time: the end the server computes for a ride (its latest group at its pace, 3 hours when nothing tells) or for a trip stage (its route at its pace, likewise) — the same as RideDto.endDateTime. On an all-day stage it is still that instant: the stage occupies every day up to it.

startPlaceName.description: Name of the meeting place, null when the ride or stage has no start place

distance.description: Distance in meters of the attached route, null when there is no route

elevationGain.description: Total elevation gain in meters of the attached route, null when there is no route

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail image URL template (contains a {size} placeholder), light variant preferred. Falls back to the route's thumbnail when the ride or stage has none of its own. For a client that renders one picture and does not follow a colour scheme; prefer thumbnailLightUrl/thumbnailDarkUrl otherwise. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

thumbnailLightUrl.description: Light-scheme thumbnail image URL template (contains a {size} placeholder). Null when the event's picture exists only in a dark variant. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

thumbnailDarkUrl.description: Dark-scheme thumbnail image URL template (contains a {size} placeholder). Null when the event's picture exists only in a light variant. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

registered.description: Whether the current user is registered to this ride, or to the trip this stage belongs to. False for an anonymous caller.

groupName.description: Name of the ride group the current user joined. Null when not registered, and always null for trip stages, which have no groups.

status.description: Publication status of the ride or stage

timezone.description: IANA zone of the ride or stage, as RideDto.timezone / TripStageDto.timezone: start and end are rendezvous in it. The calendar grid itself stays in the reader's zone.

finished.description: Whether the ride or stage is over, computed by the server when the response is built: its end (or its start, when it has no end) has passed. Independent of status.

ClientContextDto.description: Where a feedback or an error report comes from: client, device, screen

appVersion.description: Version of the client, e.g. 1.0.0 or a git commit

buildNumber.description: Build number of a mobile client

osVersion.description: OS name and version, e.g. Android 15

route.description: Path of the current page or screen, without its query string

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team being browsed, if any

ClientErrorDto.description: An unhandled error caught by a client

stack.description: Stack trace, as the client printed it

ClientLogEntryDto.description: One entry of the client's recent log

source.description: What logged it: console, http, navigation, error…

message.description: The entry, truncated by the client

startDistance.description: Start distance from route start in meters

endDistance.description: End distance from route start in meters

parts.description: Gradient segments making up the climb

name.description: Name of the climb: the route waypoint lying near its top (within 300 m), as the route's author named it in the GPX. Null when no waypoint marks the summit — clients then number the climb ("Climb N"). Never a geocoded guess.

startDistance.description: Start distance from route start in meters

endDistance.description: End distance from route start in meters

content.description: Comment content. Empty when the comment is deleted — see the deleted flag.

replyCount.description: How many replies this comment has. Equal to replies.size() when the whole thread is embedded; a client that loads threads on demand uses it to decide whether ?parentId= is worth a call. Always 0 on a reply — threading is one level deep.

deleted.description: True for the comment of a deleted account that others had answered. It stays only to carry its replies: the content is empty, and clients render a placeholder with neither author nor actions.

items.description: List of comments (top-level only, with nested replies)

itemTotal.description: How many items exist in the mode that was asked for: top-level comments normally, or replies of the requested parentId. This is what page/size iterate over.

size.description: Page size applied to items. Equals itemTotal when the caller passed no pagination parameter, since the whole tree is then returned.

confirmed.description: Must be true: the user explicitly confirmed, on a screen showing the code

singleTeam.description: Single team mode - team creation disabled

enableGpxPlanner.description: Whether the interactive planner is open in the team-independent GPX tools. When false the tools still accept a .gpx upload, only drawing from scratch is closed. Platform-admin only, per domain.

pinnedTeamSlug.description: Slug of the team the site is pinned to (dedicated hostname / alias). Null on a regular multi-team domain. When set, the app roots on this team.

mapStyles.description: Basemaps the clients may offer, in switcher order. Served rather than compiled in, so a tile provider can change without a client release.

tileServerBaseUrl.description: Public base URL of the tile host, for a client that builds its own style, sprite or glyph URLs.

defaultCenter.description: Where a map opens before it knows what it is showing. On a site rooted on one team this is that team's location; otherwise the deployment default.

terrain.description: The elevation source the clients may shade the relief with. Null when the deployment configures none — the clients then offer no relief at all rather than falling back to a provider of their own.

minSupportedAppVersion.description: Oldest mobile build this server still serves, as a semver string. Null when no floor is enforced; a client older than this should tell the user to update.

webPush.description: How the site subscribes a browser to push notifications. Null when the push channel is unavailable or the deployment configures no web app — the site then offers no notification on this device.

analytics.description: Where the site counts its page views. Null when the deployment measures no audience — the site then sends nothing. The mobile app ignores it.

gpsAutoSyncEnabled.description: Whether this deployment sends the routes of a member's rides to their GPS services on its own (GpsServiceConnectionDto.autoSync). When false the clients offer no switch: it would promise a sending that never happens.

CountResponse.description: Number of items matching a filter set

CreateDomainAliasRequest.description: Request to create a domain alias (dedicated hostname pinned to a team)

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team to pin (must belong to the domain)

androidFingerprints.description: Android app SHA-256 certificate fingerprints for passkey origin verification (comma-separated, colon-hex format)

CreateDomainRequest.description: Request to create a new domain

enableGpxPlanner.description: Whether the interactive planner is open in the GPX tools

androidFingerprints.description: Android app SHA-256 certificate fingerprints for passkey origin verification (comma-separated, colon-hex format)

CreateGpsCredentialRequest.description: Request to create a new GPS credential

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret, or consumer secret for OAuth 1.0a (required then)

oauthVersion.description: OAuth protocol of the client ID and secret (null = OAUTH2). OAUTH1 is accepted for GARMIN only; the client ID is then the consumer key

CreateInvitationRequest.description: Invite an e-mail address to join a team

email.description: Address to invite. The response is the same whether or not an account already exists for it — only the wording of the e-mail differs. Answering differently would turn this into an account-existence oracle for anyone who administers a team.

role.description: Role to grant on acceptance. Defaults to MEMBER.

DepartureWeatherDto.description: The weather at the meeting point when the ride leaves

status.description: State of the departure forecast. conditions is present for OK and STALE only.

conditions.description: The forecast of the departure hour, for OK and STALE

sunrise.description: Sunrise at the meeting point, on the departure's local date

sunset.description: Sunset at the meeting point, on the departure's local date

fetchedAt.description: When the forecast of the meeting point was last fetched

verificationUri.description: Verification URL for user to visit

verificationUriComplete.description: Verification URL with user code embedded

DeviceRegisteredGroupDto.description: Upcoming ride group the user is registered in, with the route to load on the device

groupName.description: Name of the group the user is registered in

routeSlug.description: Slug of the route to load: the group's own route, or the ride's when the group has none

startDateTime.description: When the group leaves, as an absolute instant (UTC): the group's startAt, the ride's own start when the group has no time. Devices render it in their own zone.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the ride (e.g. Europe/Paris)

syncStatuses.description: Where the route stands at each of the user's GPS services that hold it (sent automatically or uploaded by hand), so a device does not upload it again. Empty when no service holds it; a device only reads its own service's entry (Karoo: HAMMERHEAD, Garmin: GARMIN).

timezone.description: IANA zone of the ride, as RideDto.timezone; devices may ignore it and render in their own zone

DeviceRideEntryDto.description: Route entry within a ride for device applications

startDateTime.description: When this entry leaves, as an absolute instant (UTC): the group's startAt (its time on the ride's local date, in the ride's zone); the ride's own startDateTime for the ride-level route and for a group without a time. Devices render it in their own zone.

DeviceRouteDto.description: Standalone route information for device applications

DeviceRouteSyncStatusDto.description: Where the route stands at one of the user's GPS services

state.description: SENT: at the service, up to date; OUTDATED: at the service in an older version that nothing will update, send it again; PENDING: to be sent or updated shortly; FAILING: the last attempt failed (a few retries, then it waits for the route to change); RECONNECT_REQUIRED: the connection must be renewed

DeviceRoutesResponse.description: Response containing rides and routes for device applications

registeredGroups.description: Upcoming ride groups the user is registered in (from 12 hours ago to 7 days ahead), earliest first, each with the route to load

refreshToken.description: Refresh token, to keep in place of the one presented: it rotates at every refresh. Absent when the refresh came within the grace of a rotation made by another one — keep the token already held.

DeviceUserStatusResponse.description: Response containing user's device connection status

targetId.description: ID of the route or preview

lastError.description: Last error recorded, before the retry

firstRequestedAt.description: When the recomputation was first requested

ElevationRefreshRetryRequest.description: Which abandoned HD elevation recomputations to start again: the routes and GPX-tool previews whose request used up its attempts and stay on the fast profile.

dryRun.description: List what would be retried, without changing anything

limit.description: Retry at most this many targets, oldest first (default 100)

kind.description: Only this kind of target (default: both)

ElevationRefreshRetryResponse.description: Outcome of an HD elevation retry, one entry per target

dryRun.description: Whether this was a dry run (nothing changed)

matched.description: Number of abandoned targets in the domain, before the limit

items.description: Targets listed, and retried unless dry run; at most the limit

EmailChangeRequest.description: Request to change the signed-in user's email address

EmailLinkPreviewResponse.description: What a verification link is about, read without spending it: the page shows the address before anything happens, so that nobody activates someone else's account unaware.

ErrorReportRequest.description: An unhandled error, reported automatically by a client

logs.description: The client's recent log, oldest first

EventDateTime.description: Wall time without offset (2026-10-11T08:00:00), in the zone the backend resolves for the entity. An instant with Z or an offset is refused with a 400.

FeedbackRequest.description: A bug report or a suggestion written by a member

message.description: What happened, in the member's words. Required for a suggestion; optional for a bug, whose member may not know what went wrong — the context, error and log then speak for them.

error.description: The unhandled error the report was opened from, if any. Links the report to the automatic error report of the same error.

logs.description: The client's recent log, oldest first. Absent when the member chose not to attach technical details.

GeocodeResultDto.description: A place matching a geocoding query

id.description: Opaque identifier of the result, stable enough to key a list on; what GET /api/geocode/place takes to resolve the position

displayName.description: Full human-readable name of the place

lat.description: Latitude in degrees (WGS 84). Null on a search suggestion the provider gave no position for: resolve it with GET /api/geocode/place once the user picks it. Always set in that endpoint's answer.

lon.description: Longitude in degrees (WGS 84). Null exactly when lat is null: resolve it with GET /api/geocode/place once the user picks the suggestion.

GpsAutoSyncRequest.description: Turns the automatic route sync of one GPS service on or off

enabled.description: true to send the routes of the user's upcoming rides to this service automatically; false to stop, which also removes from the service the upcoming routes the sync sent

authorizationUrl.description: URL to redirect user for OAuth authorization

autoSync.description: Whether the routes of the rides the user is registered in are sent to this service automatically, and kept in sync (new route, corrected GPX, another group), from 7 days before the departure until a day after it

autoSyncState.description: Where the automatic sync stands. OFF when autoSync is false; RECONNECT_REQUIRED is only cleared by connecting the service again

autoSyncRouteCount.description: How many routes the automatic sync currently has at the service (removed after the ride, or when the sync is turned off)

lastAutoSyncAt.description: When the automatic sync last sent a route to this service

GpxPreviewDto.description: Analysed GPX file, not attached to any team

elevationState.description: Where the elevation profile stands. PENDING: the fast profile (Mapterhorn) is stored and the precise IGN LiDAR HD recomputation is scheduled. HD: the precise profile. FAST: the fast profile is kept, the HD recomputation failed.

owned.description: Whether the current user created this preview

thumbnailUrl.description: Rendered map thumbnail template URL (with a {size} placeholder), used for link previews; null when no thumbnail was generated. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

gpxUrl.description: URL to download the analysed GPX file

fitUrl.description: URL to download the analysed track as a FIT file

drawn.description: Whether the track was drawn in the route planner (true) rather than imported from a GPX file. A drawn preview can only become a route of a team whose route planner is enabled; false when the origin is unknown

GpxPreviewFromPointsRequest.description: GPX preview creation request from planner points

GpxPreviewSummaryDto.description: Summary of an analysed GPX file, for listing

leaderId.description: ID (TSID) of the member who leads this group. Must belong to the team owning the ride. Omit or send null for no designated leader — clients then show no leader at all rather than falling back on the ride's creator.

InvitationPreviewDto.description: What an invitation says, readable by whoever holds its token

inviterName.description: Display name of whoever sent the invitation

redeemable.description: Whether the invitation can still be redeemed. False for anything but a live PENDING one.

MapStyleDto.description: A basemap style the clients may offer

label.description: Human-readable label for the style switcher

group.description: Section the switcher should list this style under — 'vector', 'satellite' or 'raster'. Clients group consecutive styles sharing a value and localise the heading themselves; an unknown value is rendered as its own section rather than dropped.

url.description: URL of the MapLibre style document to load in light mode (or at all times when darkVariant is null). Either a third-party style document or, for a raster basemap the server wraps itself, a URL on /api/map/styles/{id}.json.

darkVariant.description: URL of the style document to load instead of 'url' when the client renders in dark mode. Null when the style has no dark counterpart — the client then keeps using 'url'.

attribution.description: Credit the style document does not declare itself, to be displayed IN ADDITION to the attribution the map engine derives from that document — not instead of it. Null for a style that credits itself (most of them) and for a raster basemap, whose credit is already on the source of the wrapper served at /api/map/styles/{id}.json. Non-null only where the provider ships no attribution at all, which would otherwise render the basemap uncredited.

MapTerrainDto.description: The elevation source used to shade the relief

url.description: URL of a TileJSON document describing raster-DEM tiles. The document declares the encoding; the clients do not.

maxZoom.description: Deepest zoom the provider renders. Honoured by the web, which sets it on the source; the mobile SDKs take their zoom range from the TileJSON instead.

MemberCountByRoleDto.description: Number of members of the team per role. The three figures add up to the team's memberCount.

role.description: Member role. Null when the caller is not entitled to it: an organiser reading the roster of a team that has not opened its member directory gets the names and nothing else.

joinedAt.description: When the user joined the team

ModerationDecisionRequest.description: A moderator's decision, applied to every open report of one target

action.description: REMOVE_CONTENT deletes the content (not allowed on a MEMBER); DISMISS keeps it and shows it again if reports had hidden it

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team the reports were filed in — the item's teamSlug. A member can be reported in several teams, one queue item per team: on the platform queue, this decides that item only. Omitted there, the decision applies to the target's open reports in every team. Ignored by a team's queue, whose path names the team.

ModerationItemDto.description: One reported target in a moderation queue, with all its reports in one team grouped. A member reported in two teams is two items; the item is addressed by targetType, targetId and teamSlug

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team the reports were filed in

targetUser.description: Who the moderation is about: the author of the content, or the member

contentName.description: Name of the publication — of the commented one for a comment. Null for a member, or when the content is gone.

contentType.description: Type of the content to open: the publication itself, or the one a comment is on (POST, RIDE, TRIP, ROUTE or AD). Null for a member, or when the content is gone.

contentSlug.description: Slug of the content to open, with contentType

excerpt.description: The reported text as it was when first reported (comment text, name and start of the description, or member name)

reportCount.description: How many reports this target gathered

messages.description: The non-empty free texts of the reports

firstReportedAt.description: When the first report was filed

lastReportedAt.description: When the last report was filed

hidden.description: Whether the content is currently hidden from members, having gathered enough reports

status.description: OPEN while waiting; REMOVED or DISMISSED once decided (the latest decision)

reporters.description: Who reported. Only in the platform queue: always null in a team's queue, where reporters stay anonymous.

ModerationQueueResponse.description: A moderation queue: every open target, or the 100 most recently decided ones, one item per target

MyInvitationDto.description: An invitation waiting for the current user

inviterName.description: Display name of whoever sent it

MyInvitationListResponse.description: The invitations waiting for the current user

NotificationDto.description: A notification in the current user's inbox

read.description: Whether the user has read it

actorName.description: Display name of whoever caused it, when someone did (a scheduled publication has no actor)

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team it happened in

teamName.description: Name of the team it happened in

subjectType.description: Kind of page the notification opens

subjectSlug.description: Slug of the ride, trip, post or route — of the team, for TEAM

subjectName.description: Name of the ride, trip, post or route — of the team, for TEAM

subjectDateTime.description: Date of the ride or trip, publication date of a post

subjectTimezone.description: IANA zone subjectDateTime reads in — the subject's own, as RideDto.timezone: a rendezvous, shown in it with a mention when the reader's differs. Present when subjectDateTime is, except on notifications sent before 10.20.0, which read in the reader's zone

excerpt.description: A short quote: the comment, for COMMENT_REPLY and COMMENT_ON_MY_PUBLICATION; the name of the group joined, for RIDE_JOINED

changes.description: What changed, for RIDE_UPDATED; empty otherwise

NotificationListResponse.description: A page of the current user's notifications, newest first

total.description: How many notifications match the query (unread only, if asked)

unreadCount.description: How many notifications are unread, whatever the filter

NotificationPreferenceDto.description: One cell of the notification preferences: a type on a channel

enabled.description: Whether it is delivered, as currently in effect

enabledByDefault.description: What applies when the user never touched this cell. Lets a client offer a 'restore defaults' without hard-coding them.

NotificationPreferenceUpdate.description: Switch one notification type on or off on one channel

channel.description: Delivery channel. IN_APP is refused: the inbox is always on.

channels.description: Channels that can be configured on this server, in display order

preferences.description: One cell per type and configurable channel

teams.description: The user's teams on this site, each with its mute switch. Offered whatever the channels: muting also keeps the team's announcements out of the inbox.

emailDigest.description: Non-urgent e-mails are held and sent as one digest a day, at 7:00 in the user's time zone. Cancellations, changes and reminders still leave at once. Only meaningful when EMAIL is among the channels.

teams.description: The teams to mute or unmute

emailDigest.description: Switch the daily e-mail digest on or off; absent leaves it

NotificationTeamPreferenceDto.description: Whether the current user silenced one of their teams

muted.description: Muted: none of the team's announcements (publications) reach the user, inbox included. What concerns them personally — a cancelled ride they joined, a reply — still does.

NotificationTeamPreferenceUpdate.description: Mute or unmute one of the current user's teams

teamSlug.description: Team slug — a team the user belongs to

PairedDeviceDto.description: A device (Karoo, Garmin) paired with the account by code

id.description: Pairing ID, to unpair the device

lastUsedAt.description: When the device last renewed its access

ParticipantListResponse.description: Paginated list of the people registered to a ride, a ride group or a trip

participants.description: Participants of this page, in registration order (earliest first)

total.description: Number of participants matching the search, over every page — the M of « N of M »

PasskeyRegisterRequest.description: Request to register a new passkey with device name

deviceName.description: Optional device name for this passkey

startPlace.description: Can be used as ride start point

endPlace.description: Can be used as ride end point

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the markdown body, flattened (links become their label) and cut on a word boundary at about 200 characters. Null when the body holds no text. Lets a list row render its two lines without the body being sent at all — see the 'view' parameter.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL template of the post's first image, the one a card shows. Saves a compact row from carrying media.assets just to find a picture. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

timezone.description: IANA zone the post's times were entered in and read in: the team's at its last save. dateTime, publishAt are rendezvous in this zone.

commentCount.description: Number of comments, replies included. Absent when the caller may not read the comments of this post — comments are members-only, so an outsider is told nothing, not even zero.

signedAsTeam.description: Whether the post is signed by the team rather than by its author. Readers are then not told who wrote it: createdBy is absent unless the caller administers the team or wrote the post.

createdBy.description: Who wrote the post. Absent when the post is signed by the team (signedAsTeam) and the caller neither administers the team nor wrote it — render the team instead.

tags.description: The team's POST tags the post carries, sorted by label. Empty when it carries none.

dateTime.description: Post date/time: a wall time without offset, read in the team's zone.

publishAt.description: Publication time (for scheduled publishing), a wall time in the team's zone like dateTime.

signedAsTeam.description: Sign the post as the team rather than as its author. Omitted: on creation, the team's postsAsTeamByDefault; on an update, left as it is.

tagIds.description: IDs (TSID) of the team's POST tags the post carries, replacing the whole set — at most 10, each a tag of this team and of kind POST, else 400 (TAG_INVALID, TOO_MANY_TAGS). An empty list removes them all. Omitted: none on a creation, left as they are on an update.

ProfileNotificationSummaryDto.description: Where the current user's notifications go, summed up

channels.description: Channels that can be configured on this server, in display order

enabledChannels.description: Among channels, those on which at least one notification type is turned on for the user (their choices, or the defaults they never changed)

emailDigest.description: Whether non-urgent e-mails are held for a daily digest. Always false when EMAIL is not among channels.

ProfileParticipationSummaryDto.description: The rides and trips the current user is registered to, summed up

next.description: The next outing, in the compact list view (no markdown body): empty when nothing is coming up, never more than one row

ProfileSummaryDto.description: The state of each subject of the current user's profile, for its overview

participations.description: Rides and trips the user is registered to

teams.description: The user's teams on this site, in name order, each with the user's role in it

passkeyCount.description: Number of passkeys registered on the account

pairedDevices.description: Devices (Karoo, Garmin) paired with the account, newest first — the same rows as GET /api/users/me/devices

blockedUserCount.description: Number of live accounts the user blocked

ProfileTeamDto.description: One of the current user's teams, with the user's role in it

role.description: The user's role in the team

PushDeviceRegistration.description: A device to receive push notifications on

token.description: The FCM registration token. Registering a token already known moves it to the current user and refreshes its last-seen date.

deviceName.description: A human-readable device name, for the member's own device list

appVersion.description: The app version that registered, for support

PushDeviceUnregistration.description: A device to stop sending push notifications to

token.description: The FCM registration token to drop

acceptTerms.description: The member accepted the terms of service. Required, and must be true: the sign-up form asks for it with a checkbox.

ReportRequest.description: A report of a comment, a publication, an ad, a route or a member

teamSlug.description: The team the target belongs to. Its organizers and administrators moderate the report.

targetId.description: ID (TSID) of the comment, publication, ad or route — or of the user for a MEMBER

message.description: Optional free text for the moderators, up to 500 characters

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the markdown body, flattened (links become their label) and cut on a word boundary at about 200 characters. Null when the body holds no text. Lets a list row render its two lines without the body being sent at all — see the 'view' parameter.

timezone.description: IANA zone the ride's times were entered in and read in: its start place's, else its route's, else the team's. dateTime, publishAt, endDateTime and the groups' startAt are rendezvous in this zone.

endDateTime.description: When the ride is over, computed by the server: the latest of its groups, each one its departure plus its route's length at its average speed — or plus 3 hours when the group has no speed or no route, and for a ride with no group. What the upcoming and past lists (when=UPCOMING|PAST) and the calendar read.

finished.description: Whether the ride is over, computed by the server when the response is built: its start time has passed. Independent of status — a past cancelled ride is both CANCELLED and finished.

groupSummaries.description: Every group of the ride in sort order, as a card shows it: name, pace, start time and fill (countParticipants against maxParticipants). Filled on list rows too, where groups is empty — a card draws its per-group fill bars without opening the ride. Carries no leader nor participants: those are on groups, in the detail.

distance.description: Distance in meters of the ride's route — or, when the ride itself has none, of the route of its first group (in sort order) that has one. Null when no route is set anywhere.

elevationGain.description: Total elevation gain in meters, from the same route as distance. Null when no route is set anywhere.

surfaceType.description: Surface type, from the same route as distance. Null when no route is set anywhere.

thumbnailLightUrl.description: Thumbnail URL (light). Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

thumbnailDarkUrl.description: Thumbnail URL (dark). Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

thumbnailUrl.description: The one thumbnail to show when the client does not theme its cards: the light variant if there is one, else the dark one. Saves a compact row from carrying media.assets just to find a picture. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

registered.description: Whether the current user is registered in one of this ride's groups. False if anonymous.

registeredGroupId.description: ID (TSID) of the group the current user joined, null if not registered

registeredGroup.description: The group the current user joined, in full — the same object as the matching entry of groups. Null if not registered or anonymous. Set on list rows too, where groups is empty: a client rendering "my next ride" needs no second request for its group. Its leader is the group's own, null when none was designated.

full.description: Whether every group of the ride has reached its capacity. False when the ride has no group, or when at least one group has no maxParticipants.

maxParticipants.description: Capacity of the whole ride: the sum of its groups' maxParticipants, to render participantCount against it ("12/40"). Null when the ride has no group, or when at least one group has no maxParticipants — the ride then has no overall limit, and is never full. Set on list rows too, where groups is empty.

commentCount.description: Number of comments, replies included. Absent when the caller may not read the comments of this ride — comments are members-only, so an outsider is told nothing, not even zero.

tags.description: The team's RIDE tags the ride carries, sorted by label. Empty when it carries none.

weather.description: The weather line of a card: the meeting point, over the window from the departure to the estimated arrival of the last group. Absent when there is nothing to show — finished or cancelled ride, no place, forecast not in cache yet; present only with status OK, STALE or NOT_YET_AVAILABLE. The full forecast is getRideWeather.

time.description: Deprecated in favour of startAt, for display: the group's start as a wall time of the ride's zone, null when it leaves with the ride. What an editor sends back as GroupRequest.time.

startAt.description: When the group leaves: its time on the ride's local date in the ride's zone, the ride's dateTime when it has no time of its own.

participants.description: The first participants of the group (at most 8), earliest registrations first — enough to draw avatars. countParticipants is the total; the whole list is paginated and searched by GET …/rides/{rideSlug}/participants?groupId=.

registered.description: Whether the current user is registered in THIS group. False if anonymous.

full.description: Whether the group has reached maxParticipants. False when maxParticipants is not set.

distance.description: Distance in meters of the group route, if it has one

elevationGain.description: Total elevation gain in meters of the group route, if it has one

leader.description: The member who leads this group, when one is designated. Null means no leader was designated — render nothing rather than falling back on the ride's creator, who is the same person on every group of the ride.

thumbnailLightUrl.description: Thumbnail URL (light) of the group route, if it has one. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

thumbnailDarkUrl.description: Thumbnail URL (dark) of the group route, if it has one. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

thumbnailUrl.description: The one thumbnail of the group route to show when the client does not theme its cards: the light variant if there is one, else the dark one. Null when the group has no route or its route has no thumbnail — the ride's own thumbnail is then the one to fall back on. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

RideGroupSummaryDto.description: One group of a ride, as a list row shows it: name, pace and fill. Same figures as the matching entry of the detail's groups, without the participants nor the leader.

time.description: Start time of the group, when it differs from the ride's

startAt.description: When the group leaves, as RideGroupDto.startAt. Replaces time, kept for the clients that still read it.

maxParticipants.description: Maximum participants, null when the group is uncapped

full.description: Whether the group has reached maxParticipants. False when maxParticipants is not set.

routeSlug.description: Slug of the group route, if it has one

distance.description: Distance in meters of the group route, if it has one

elevationGain.description: Total elevation gain in meters of the group route, if it has one

dateTime.description: Ride date/time: a wall time without offset, read in the ride's zone (start place, else route, else team).

publishAt.description: Publication time (for scheduled publishing), a wall time in the ride's zone like dateTime.

tagIds.description: IDs (TSID) of the team's RIDE tags the ride carries, replacing the whole set — at most 10, each a tag of this team and of kind RIDE, else 400 (TAG_INVALID, TOO_MANY_TAGS). An empty list removes them all. Omitted: none on a creation, left as they are on an update.

templateId.description: ID (TSID) of the team's template the ride is created from. On a creation, raises the template's nextNumber by one when it has one; ignored on an update, and when the template no longer exists.

tags.description: The team's RIDE tags of the template, sorted by label. Copied onto a ride created from it: a client prefills the ride's tagIds with them, editable before and after.

nextNumber.description: The number the next ride created from this template takes: a client prefills the ride's name with « name #nextNumber » and sends RideRequest.templateId, which raises it by one. Null: the template numbers nothing.

status.description: Default status for rides created from this template

tagIds.description: IDs (TSID) of the team's RIDE tags the template carries (copied onto the rides created from it), replacing the whole set — at most 10, each a tag of this team and of kind RIDE, else 400 (TAG_INVALID, TOO_MANY_TAGS). An empty list removes them all. Omitted: none on a creation, left as they are on an update.

nextNumber.description: The number the next ride created from this template takes: a client titles it « name #nextNumber » and the creation of that ride (RideRequest.templateId) raises it by one. Null: the template numbers nothing.

RideWeatherDto.description: A ride's weather, for its detail page: the meeting point at departure, then one leg per group. Read from the server's cache only — the forecast is refreshed in the background, never on request.

status.description: Overall state. OK and STALE (shown, flagged as old) carry the forecast; NOT_YET_AVAILABLE comes with availableFrom; UNAVAILABLE (nothing in cache yet, or the provider failing) offers to retry; NO_LOCATION is worth a word to the organisers only; OUT_OF_RANGE (finished, cancelled) shows nothing.

availableFrom.description: For NOT_YET_AVAILABLE: when the forecast opens, seven days before the departure

fetchedAt.description: The oldest fetch among the forecasts read

legs.description: One per group, in group order; a single one without groupId for a ride without groups. Empty for OUT_OF_RANGE, NO_LOCATION and NOT_YET_AVAILABLE.

attribution.description: The credit the forecast's licence asks for

RideWeatherSummaryDto.description: A ride's weather on a card, at the meeting point, over the window from the departure to the estimated arrival of the last group — or a trip stage's, over its checkpoints. Only OK, STALE and NOT_YET_AVAILABLE are ever sent; for NOT_YET_AVAILABLE only status and availableFrom are set.

availableFrom.description: For NOT_YET_AVAILABLE: when the forecast opens, seven days before the departure

weatherCode.description: WMO code at the departure hour

condition.description: weatherCode folded into a condition, same table as WeatherConditionsDto.condition

daylight.description: Whether the departure itself (not the round model hour read for it) is between sunrise and sunset

temperature.description: Air temperature at the departure hour, °C

maxPrecipitationProbability.description: Highest probability of precipitation over the window, %. Absent when the model gives none.

rainAlert.description: The first hour of the window with rain likely (50 % or more). Its distance is absent on a ride's summary, present on a trip stage's (the checkpoint's)

timezone.description: IANA zone the times of this summary (rain alert) are read in, as rendezvous with no zone mention. Set on a trip's card, where it is its next stage's zone — not TripDto.timezone, the first stage's. Absent elsewhere: the owner's timezone (RideDto, TripStageDto) applies.

RouteBoundsResponse.description: Bounding box of the routes matching a filter set

bounds.description: Bounding box, or null when no route matches

elevationState.description: Where the elevation profile stands. PENDING: the fast profile (Mapterhorn) is stored and the precise IGN LiDAR HD recomputation is scheduled. HD: the precise profile. FAST: the fast profile is kept, the HD recomputation failed.

tracks.description: Tracks, with the stored geometry untouched — every coordinate carries longitude, latitude, elevation and cumulative distance in meters. Empty when the bulk endpoint was called with 'geometry=false'.

commentCount.description: Number of comments, replies included. Absent when the caller may not read the comments of this route — comments are members-only, so an outsider is told nothing, not even zero.

tags.description: The team's ROUTE tags the route carries, sorted by label. Empty when it carries none.

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the description, flattened (links become their label) and cut on a word boundary at about 200 characters. Null when the description holds no text. Lets a list row render its two lines without the description being sent at all — see the 'view' parameter.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL template of the route's thumbnail, light variant if there is one, else dark. Saves a compact row from carrying media.assets just to find the map preview. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

elevationState.description: Where the elevation profile stands. PENDING: the fast profile (Mapterhorn) is stored and the precise IGN LiDAR HD recomputation is scheduled. HD: the precise profile. FAST: the fast profile is kept, the HD recomputation failed.

commentCount.description: Number of comments, replies included. Absent when the caller may not read the comments of this route — comments are members-only, so an outsider is told nothing, not even zero.

tags.description: The team's ROUTE tags the route carries, sorted by label. Empty when it carries none.

visibility.description: Whether the route is publicly visible

tagIds.description: IDs (TSID) of the team's ROUTE tags the route carries, replacing the whole set — at most 10, each a tag of this team and of kind ROUTE, else 400 (TAG_INVALID, TOO_MANY_TAGS). An empty list removes them all. Omitted: none on a creation, left as they are on an update.

RouteUploadResponse.description: Result of uploading a route to a GPS service

externalRouteId.description: External route ID on the GPS service

RouteUsageDto.description: A ride or trip that uses a route

timezone.description: IANA zone of the publication, as RideDto.timezone / TripDto.timezone: dateTime and endDate are rendezvous in it.

endDate.description: For a trip, the date of its last stage — the same value as TripDto.endDate. Null for a ride, and for a trip with no stage, which lasts a day.

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team owning the publication

referencedDirectly.description: Whether the publication references the route directly (not only via a child)

viaChildNames.description: Names of the ride groups or trip stages that reference the route, if any

RouteUsagesResponse.description: Rides and trips that use a route

usages.description: Usages of the route, most recent first

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team the route is being drawn for. When present, the team must have the route planner enabled and the caller must be allowed to create routes in it. When absent, the domain's GPX planner must be enabled.

RoutesBulkResponse.description: Detail of several routes fetched at once, plus their combined extent

routes.description: Route details, one per readable requested slug

extent.description: Bounding box of every returned route, or null when routes is empty

SitemapDto.description: Every page of the site a search engine may index: the public content of public teams, without classified ads nor routes. Capped at 50,000 entries, the sitemap protocol's limit; newest first within each type.

SitemapEntryDto.description: One indexable page. The API returns slugs, not URLs: the path is localised and belongs to the client's route table.

teamSlug.description: Slug of the team the page belongs to

tripSlug.description: Slug of the trip a TRIP_STAGE belongs to; null for every other type

slug.description: Slug of the page itself; null for TEAM and TEAM_ABOUT

lastModified.description: Last modification of the page's content

slug.description: New slug (lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only)

dateTime.description: Stage date/time: a wall time without offset, read in the stage's zone (start place, else route, else the previous stage's, else the trip route's, else the team's).

type.description: Kind of content the tag applies to

label.description: Label, trimmed; unique in the team and kind whatever the case, at most 32 characters once trimmed (TAG_LABEL_INVALID otherwise)

detachedCount.description: Contents the tag was detached from, counted like usageCount (trashed contents lose it too, uncounted)

TagDto.description: A team tag on a content

TagUpdateRequest.description: Tag update request — absent fields are unchanged

label.description: New label, trimmed, at most 32 characters once trimmed (TAG_LABEL_INVALID otherwise)

TagWithUsageDto.description: A team tag with its usage count

type.description: Kind of content the tag applies to

usageCount.description: Contents carrying the tag: rides, posts, trips, routes and ads out of the trash, plus ride templates — what a deletion would detach it from

TeamDashboardAdminDto.description: The administration panel of a team dashboard. The split of the members per role is team.memberCountByRole, the enabled modules the team's enable* flags.

newestMembers.description: The newest members, latest joined first (at most 3), with role and joinedAt. total is the member count.

webhook.description: The team's webhook: configured, kind, enabled, lastStatus, lastAttemptAt. The URL only comes masked.

TeamDashboardDto.description: A team's dashboard for one of its members, or its public part for a visitor. Each section is a short page (at most 5 rows) of the matching list, compact rows, deleted content left out; its total is what the full list holds. A section is null when its module is disabled for the team. The organizer block is null for a MEMBER, the admin block null below ADMIN. For a visitor (role null) only team, upcomingRides, latestPosts and newRoutes are filled.

team.description: The team, as GET /api/teams/{teamSlug} returns it — header, feature flags, memberCount; memberCountByRole is filled for an administrator.

role.description: The caller's role in the team, the one the sections were built for. ADMIN for a platform admin; null for a visitor, anonymous or not a member.

myUpcoming.description: « Vos prochaines sorties »: the team's rides and trips starting from now that the caller is registered to, soonest first (at most 3). A ride row's registeredGroup is the group joined, with its pace. Null when both rides and trips are disabled, and for a visitor.

upcomingRides.description: « Sorties à venir »: the team's published rides starting from now, soonest first (at most 3). Each row carries groupSummaries (fill per group), distance, elevationGain, surfaceType, registered and commentCount. Null when rides are disabled.

latestPosts.description: « Dernières publications »: the team's latest published posts, newest first (at most 3). Null when posts are disabled.

newRoutes.description: « Nouveaux parcours »: the team's latest routes, newest first (at most 3). Null when routes are disabled.

latestAds.description: « Annonces »: the team's latest ads, newest first (at most 3). A null price reads « Prix à négocier »; the place is locationDescription, a sector — never a pin. Null when ads are disabled, and for a visitor.

organizer.description: What organizers and administrators see on top. Null for a MEMBER and a visitor.

admin.description: The administration panel. Null below ADMIN, and for a visitor.

TeamDashboardOrganizerDto.description: The organizer part of a team dashboard: the « À traiter » tiles and the ride templates. Each list is a short page (at most 5 rows); its total is the tile's figure.

drafts.description: The team's drafts (rides, posts, trips), newest first. total is the number of drafts, the rows their names.

ridesWithoutRoute.description: Published rides starting from now routed nowhere — neither the ride nor any of its groups has a route — soonest first. Same rows as GET …/publications?type=RIDE&withoutRoute=true. Null when rides are disabled.

ridesWithFullGroup.description: Published rides starting from now with at least one group at capacity, soonest first. Same rows as GET …/publications?type=RIDE&withFullGroup=true. Null when rides are disabled.

reports.description: The open reports of the team's moderation queue

rideTemplates.description: « Créer depuis un modèle »: the team's ride templates (at most 5), each with its groupCount. Null when rides are disabled.

TeamDashboardReportsDto.description: The reports tile of a team dashboard. The full queue is GET /api/teams/{teamSlug}/reports?status=OPEN; reporters are never named.

openCount.description: Reported targets waiting for a decision — the number of items of the open queue

latestReason.description: Reason of the most recent open report, null when none

latestTargetType.description: What the most recent open report is about, null when none

latestExcerpt.description: The reported text as it was when the most recent open report was filed, null when none

latestReportedAt.description: When the most recent open report was filed, null when none

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the about page, flattened and cut on a word boundary at about 200 characters. Null when the about page holds no text. Lets a team card render its two lines without parsing the markdown client-side.

logoUrl.description: URL template of the team's logo, when it has one. Same picture as about.assets.logo, hoisted so a card does not have to walk the asset inventory to find it. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

enableMemberDirectory.description: Whether the member directory is readable by every member and not just by administrators. Clients use it to decide whether to offer the directory at all: an entry that always leads to a 403 is worse than no entry. Organisers see the directory whatever its value, but only get each member's role and join date when it is true.

postsAsTeamByDefault.description: Whether a new post starts signed by the team rather than by its author — the initial value of the editor's « on behalf of the team » box.

visibilityEditable.description: Whether visibility is editable by team admins

joinable.description: Whether any domain user can join this team

addMemberAllowed.description: Whether team admins can add members

enableRoutePlanner.description: Whether the interactive route planner is open to this team. Unlike enableRoutes it never hides the routes section: when false the track can still be imported or replaced from a GPX file, only drawing is closed. Platform-admin only.

upcomingRideCount.description: Rides of this team dated in the future that the caller may open. Follows the same visibility rules as the ride listing, so it never announces more than the caller can actually see.

routeCount.description: Routes of this team the caller may open, under the same visibility rules as the route listing.

upcomingTripCount.description: Trips of this team starting in the future that the caller may open, under the same visibility rules as the trip listing. 0 when trips are disabled.

recentPostCount.description: Published posts of this team dated within the last 7 days (and not in the future) that the caller may open, under the same visibility rules as the post listing. Feeds the activity line of a member's team card. 0 when posts are disabled.

memberCountByRole.description: Members per role. Only for the team's administrators (platform admins included): null for everyone else, and in the team listings.

role.description: Current user's role (null if not a member)

timezone.description: The team's IANA zone: the one its rides, trips and posts fall back on when no place locates them. Administrators change it through TeamRequest.timezone.

TeamInvitationDto.description: A pending or settled invitation to join a team

expiresAt.description: When the invitation stops being redeemable

acceptedAt.description: When it was accepted, if it was

TeamInvitationListResponse.description: Paginated list of a team's invitations

logoUrl.description: URL template of the team's logo (with a {size} placeholder), when it has one. Same value as TeamDetailDto.logoUrl, so a publication can show its team's logo without loading the team. Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.

enableMemberDirectory.description: Member directory readable by every member, not just administrators. Organisers always see the directory; what this flag adds for them is the role and join date of each member.

postsAsTeamByDefault.description: Whether a new post starts signed by the team rather than by its author. Omitted: left as it is (on for a new team).

timezone.description: The team's IANA zone (Europe/Paris): the one its rides, trips and posts fall back on when no place locates them. Validated against the JDK's timezone database, else 400 INVALID_TIMEZONE. Omitted: Europe/Paris on a creation, left as it is on an update. Changing it keeps the wall time of the upcoming rides, trips and posts that no place locates.

TeamTimezoneChangeItemDto.description: An upcoming place-less event that keeps its wall time in the new zone

title.description: Event title; a stage's own name

tripTitle.description: For a stage, the title of its trip

dateTime.description: Start, as stored today: read it in the team's current zone for the wall time it keeps

TeamTimezoneChangePreviewDto.description: Preview of a change of the team's zone; nothing is written

upcomingCount.description: How many upcoming place-less events keep their wall time

pastCount.description: How many past place-less events keep their instant, relabelled

upcoming.description: The first upcoming ones, soonest first, at most 10

TeamTimezoneDto.description: The zone of a point, else the team's

timezone.description: IANA zone of the point; the team's own when no point is given or the point lies outside every zone

configured.description: Whether the team has a webhook at all

maskedUrl.description: The URL, masked: scheme, host and the last characters only

kind.description: Message format, read from the URL

language.description: Language the messages are written in

lastError.description: Why the latest attempt failed, when it did

lastAttemptAt.description: When the latest attempt was made

TeamWebhookRequest.description: Create or change a team's webhook

url.description: The https URL to post to. Omit it to keep the one already set — the API never returns it in full. Required when the team has no webhook yet.

language.description: Language the messages are written in

TeamWebhookTestDto.description: Outcome of a test message sent to the team's webhook

statusCode.description: HTTP status the endpoint answered, if it answered

error.description: Why it failed, when it did

bytes.description: Stored size in bytes, -1 when the file is missing

ThumbnailOwnerReport.description: A route, ride or trip whose thumbnails were (or would be) redrawn

after.description: Its thumbnails after, absent on a dry run

error.description: Error message when the regeneration itself failed

ThumbnailRegenerationRequest.description: Which map thumbnails to redraw from the geometry already stored. The criteria combine: the date window and the size threshold narrow the thumbnails that exist, the 'missing' flag adds the entities that have none. At least one criterion is required.

renderedFrom.description: Only thumbnails drawn at or after this instant

renderedTo.description: Only thumbnails drawn before this instant

suspectBelowBytes.description: Only thumbnails whose stored file is smaller than this many bytes, or has no file. A map drawn without its background weighs a few kB, a real one tens.

includeMissing.description: Also redraw the routes, rides and trips that have a route to draw but lack a light or dark thumbnail — what a failed render leaves behind

dryRun.description: List what would be redrawn, without redrawing anything

limit.description: Redraw at most this many entities (default 100)

ThumbnailRegenerationResponse.description: Outcome of a thumbnail regeneration, one entry per entity

dryRun.description: Whether this was a dry run (nothing redrawn)

matched.description: Number of entities matching the criteria, before the limit

entities.description: Entities processed, at most the limit

TileTokenDto.description: Short-lived token authorizing vector tile requests

token.description: Token to pass as the 't' query parameter of the .mvt endpoints

expiresAt.description: Absolute expiry instant (ISO 8601), for logs and diagnostics

expiresIn.description: Seconds until expiry, measured at issuance. Schedule renewal on this, not on expiresAt: it is immune to a device clock that drifts.

climbs.description: List of climbs on the route

excerpt.description: Plain-text opening of the markdown body, flattened (links become their label) and cut on a word boundary at about 200 characters. Null when the body holds no text. Lets a list row render its two lines without the body being sent at all — see the 'view' parameter.

timezone.description: IANA zone the trip's times were entered in and read in: its first stage's, else its route's, else the team's. dateTime, endDate, endDateTime and publishAt are rendezvous in this zone.

endDate.description: Date of the last stage — the day the trip ends. Null when the trip has no stage, in which case it lasts a day and dateTime is both ends.

endDateTime.description: When the trip is over, computed by the server: the end of its latest stage — its departure plus its route's length at its average speed, or plus 3 hours when the stage has no speed or no route — or dateTime plus 3 hours for a trip with no stage. What the upcoming and past lists (when=UPCOMING|PAST) and the calendar read.

finished.description: Whether the trip is over, computed by the server when the response is built: its last stage (endDate, or dateTime when there is none) has started. Independent of status — a past cancelled trip is both CANCELLED and finished.

totalDistance.description: Distance in metres over every stage that has a route. Null when no stage has one — an unrouted trip has no distance, which is not the same as a distance of zero.

totalElevationGain.description: Elevation gain in metres over every stage that has a route. Null when no stage has one.

participants.description: The first participants of the trip (at most 8), earliest registrations first — enough to draw avatars; empty on a list row. participantCount is the total; the whole list is paginated and searched by GET …/trips/{tripSlug}/participants.

thumbnailLightUrl.description: Thumbnail URL (light). Opaque URL: may carry a query string; substitute {size} only.
